description:
Fruittari or Fruittarit (for groups) is a fashion movement and a subculture that emerged in Finland during the mid-2000s to early 2010s, with a term defining teenage boys who pay close attention and take pride in their appearance. The "Fruittari" originated from the term "Fruitcake", which is translated in Finnish. Alongside contemporary spaces such as Hopparit (Hip-hop ties) or Pissikset (A girl version), they shared groups online through social platforms like IRC-Galleria.

The main components of the style incorporate tight skinny jeans, distinct layered hairstyles, branded hoodies, and accessories like large-buckled belts, defying narrow and traditional 2000s masculine norms similar to the Gyaruo , Scene , and Partille-Johnny aesthetic.
